sections.title: Imports and test document builders
sections.what: Brings in the test tools, the verification functions and the document type, and builds helpers that create sample documents and run one rule on them.
sections.why: Likely reason: small builders keep each test focused on one rule.
sections.watch_out: The default sample text is shared, so changing a default changes many tests at once.

sections.name: deterministic verification
sections.title: Verification rule checks
sections.what: Checks that the hero gets area and family potential issues with their source documents, that the control has no potential issue, that equal areas written in different number forms pass, and that malformed or unsupported area text gives insufficient evidence. Also checks family names match after tidying, that only one labelled acre value is read, and that repeated runs and stored results are identical.
sections.why: Likely reason: each rule has a clear expected answer, and these tests prove it.
sections.watch_out: The malformed-value cases are checked in a loop, so a new bad value is only tested if someone adds it to the list.

summary: Tests the deterministic checks that compare area and family-holder information across the demo documents.
purpose: Confirms the hero case flags the expected potential issues with their sources, the control stays clean, unclear values are handled safely, and results are repeatable and stored.
why: Likely reason: verification is the core of the demo's trust, so it is pinned by tests that show the same input always gives the same output.
how: Section one imports the parser and service and builds helpers that make sample documents and run one rule. Section two runs the hero and control cases and checks their outcomes, that equal numbers in different forms pass, that malformed or unsupported areas give insufficient evidence, that family names match after tidying, that only one labelled acre value is accepted, and that repeated runs match the stored list.
inputs: Demo case identifiers and short sample document texts.
outputs: A pass or fail result for each test.
risks: The sample texts are short and hand-written, so real document formats are not covered.
debug: If an outcome changes, read the sample text in the failing test and compare it with the rule in the verification service.
